Refine the following review experience for the SIGN dimension. Make it concise, actionable, and specific.

Topic: Evaluating Significance and Impact in Interpretability Papers
Content: When reviewing the SIGN dimension for interpretability methods, assess whether the work addresses a broadly important problem (SIGN-BRD). Critically evaluate domain impact (SIGN-DOM) by checking if the method is demonstrated on complex, high-dimensional real-world tasks rather than just simple benchmarks like MNIST. Verify improvements over state-of-the-art (SIGN-SOT) by ensuring quantitative comparisons against established baselines (e.g., LIME, SHAP) and objective metrics for 'intuitiveness'. Finally, check for real-world and societal impact (SIGN-IMP) discussions, including fairness, risks of misleading explanations, and computational sustainability.

Return only the refined content.
